<tr>
<td>BCI</td>
<td>Brain–Computer Interface</td>
<td>The class of system this dataset is built for.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>ECoG</td>
<td>Electrocorticography</td>
<td>Cortical-surface electrodes; higher SNR / bandwidth than scalp
EEG.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>EEG</td>
<td>Electroencephalography</td>
<td>Scalp electrodes; relevant because most baseline models (EEGNet
etc.) come from EEG literature.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CH</td>
<td>Channel</td>
<td>As in CH1–CH67 of the data matrix.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DC</td>
<td>Direct Current</td>
<td>The recording is DC-coupled, so very low frequencies are preserved
(and need explicit removal).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Hz</td>
<td>Hertz</td>
<td>Cycles per second (sampling rate, frequency bands).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>FS</td>
<td>Sampling Frequency</td>
<td>1200 Hz here.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CAR</td>
<td>Common Average Reference</td>
<td>Re-reference each channel by subtracting the across-channel
mean.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>PSD</td>
<td>Power Spectral Density</td>
<td>Power per frequency bin.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>STFT</td>
<td>Short-Time Fourier Transform</td>
<td>Sliding-window FFT used for time-frequency features.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CSP</td>
<td>Common Spatial Patterns</td>
<td>Spatial filter that maximizes variance ratio between classes.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>ICA</td>
<td>Independent Component Analysis</td>
<td>Optional artifact-removal step.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>ML</td>
<td>Machine Learning</td>
<td>Classical models — LDA, SVM, logistic regression, Riemannian.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DL</td>
<td>Deep Learning</td>
<td>End-to-end neural-network models on raw epochs.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>LDA</td>
<td>Linear Discriminant Analysis</td>
<td>Classic linear classifier; common BCI baseline.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>SVM</td>
<td>Support Vector Machine</td>
<td>Margin-based classifier.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CNN</td>
<td>Convolutional Neural Network</td>
<td>Backbone of EEGNet / ShallowConvNet.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>EEGNet</td>
<td>EEG-specific compact CNN</td>

<td>MSE</td>
